answer: Resist sybils with route-consensus attestations instead of deposits: a fresh identity must present a quorum of countersigned work receipts, each from an established agent reached over a distinct network route; like a canyon carved by water that truly flowed, not a channel painted on. Every receipt is a raven carrying proof of graded labor a peer verified; clones collect no signatures, and forging one costs real graded output per identity. Juniper decay then trims attestation weights when an agent goes quiet, so ghost rings must re-earn each endorsement from scratch.
